netscape.title: Britain’s Uniform Penny Post begins
netscape.line: A flat one-penny stamp made letters affordable to almost everyone, and the number sent in Britain more than doubled in the first year.

springs.title: Amrita Devi dies defending trees
springs.line: Amrita Devi refused to let Marwar’s men fell khejri trees; 363 Bishnois died with her and the maharaja banned felling there.

springs.title: Marsh publishes Man and Nature
springs.line: George Perkins Marsh’s book warned that people were ruining the land, and it helped launch the conservation movement and national forests.

sputnik.title: France launches the ironclad Gloire
sputnik.line: France launched Gloire, the first ocean-going ironclad, and alarmed Britain answered with the bigger iron-hulled HMS Warrior, starting a naval race.
